title: Revive Old Macs & Level Up omg.lol — 2 macOS Tools Explained  #github
description:
Today, we’ve got two brand-new, developer-friendly macOS apps that solve real problems with clean native design and zero nonsense workflows.

One helps you resurrect old Intel Macs from an Apple Silicon machine — no Terminal, no pain.

https://github.com/Kruszoneq/macUSB

The other brings the entire omg.lol ecosystem straight to your Mac with a beautifully native SwiftUI experience.

https://github.com/otaviocc/Triton
